create_SSLCertRefresher: create an SSLCertRefresher to monitor and reload SSL certificate files when they change
test_SSLCertRefresher_init: test the SSLCertRefresher initialization with an SSLContext, key path, cert path, and optional CA path
run_SSLCertRefresher_stop: run the SSLCertRefresher stop method to cancel all file watching tasks
refactor_SSLCertRefresher_watch_files: refactor the SSLCertRefresher _watch_files method to support watching multiple file paths asynchronously
review_SSLCertRefresher_cert_reload: review the SSLCertRefresher cert chain reload callback that calls load_cert_chain on file change
